proof_requests: Send a full photo of the entire sewing machine (head + bed/stand + motor area).
Send a clear close-up of the motor/drive connection showing whether it is direct-drive or belt-driven.
Send a working video: threaded machine sewing a short line of fabric (with foot pedal/power visible).
Send a photo of the nameplate/serial plate with brand and model.
